items.title: Isaiah Likely: Another big day in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Likely caught six of 11 targets for 99 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Zero touches in Week 6 loss
items.text:

items.title: J.J. McCarthy: Leads late comeback attempt in Week 6 loss
items.text:
McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints, completing 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards and one touchdown with one interception.
